summary.text: Night Temptress is a rank seven concubine of Thousand Transformations Ancestor sent with Immortal Concubine Qing Lan to investigate a trapped dream realm.

claims.text: Thousand Transformations Ancestor sends two rank seven female immortals to investigate after his will, Mutation Immortal Gu, and Dancer Hong Yun are trapped. Narration names them Night Temptress and Immortal Concubine Qing Lan. Against the dream realm they are helpless until a mysterious sound path voice tips them toward Fairy Cui Bo.

She and Immortal Concubine Qing Lan fly around a conspicuous red dream realm and set Gu worms to form an immortal Gu formation that seals it. Night Temptress defends while Immortal Concubine Qing Lan finishes the final steps. Among the concubines, Night Temptress has the highest status and strength, and Immortal Concubine Qing Lan is second. After Pass Gu seats the formation core and a light yellow cloud forms, both sigh in relief and say they can return almost instantly.

When Fang Yuan attacks the yellow cloud, Night Temptress teleports in at the front of the reinforcing concubines. Narration calls her the number one concubine of Thousand Transformations Ancestor. She tells Immortal Concubine Qing Lan that it is not time yet for husband to move, and that they received the order to help defend. As the cloud shrinks she orders the others to reinforce, exhausts herself until she coughs blood, then decides they must activate the final method that hardens the remnant cloud with golden rays. When a disguised Thousand Transformations Ancestor reveals himself, she and Immortal Concubine Qing Lan shout husband in surprise and joy.

Narration states Thousand Transformations Ancestor had no choice but to send Night Temptress and Immortal Concubine Qing Lan to construct a rank seven immortal formation around the dream realm, and that this action exposed his state to Heavenly Court.

Under continuous Heavenly Court assault a corner of the myriad li adaptation formation collapses. Most of the female immortals inside fall unconscious from backlash; only Night Temptress remains barely conscious. She calls for husband as Wei Feng enters. Wei Feng grabs her, then dies when the figure holding his head lets out rank eight aura and changes appearance into Thousand Transformations Ancestor.

Fang Yuan reads that the real Night Temptress should be inside Myriad Statue Palace assisting in controlling it, while the real Thousand Transformations Ancestor had disguised as Night Temptress among the concubines to protect them and use them as bait.
Narration recalls that when Night Temptress and Immortal Concubine Qing Lan first set an immortal formation, rank seven rule path Immortal Gu Pass was its core.
